authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 10158 mukha explicitly gives mouth/face mu/muh and retained-kh mukha forms. The simple survey moho/māī and mukh responses preserve these attested contractions or learned/regional forms. Reviewed comparison: RathwiBareli mui “face” (f_rdisajhwws75q). The family link leaves local phonetic details and possible transfer between Indo-Aryan languages open; no source spelling is changed.

The family link leaves local phonetic details and possible transfer between Indo-Aryan languages open; no source spelling is changed.

Reviewed comparison: Bshk mūɬ “urine” (f_5oc2736gup5mi). The family link leaves local phonetic details and possible transfer between Indo-Aryan languages open; no source spelling is changed.
